facts.text: Every test run should record an immutable identifier for everything that can change its result: software build, parameter or calibration set, machine-learning model weights and training-data manifest, simulator version, sensor-model version, terrain and map assets, scenario file, random seed, and HIL rig configuration.
facts.quote: Everything that can change a result gets an immutable identifier recorded with the run:

facts.text: Content hashes should be used to identify result-affecting artifacts recorded with test runs.
facts.quote: Use content hashes, as common data- and model-versioning tools do (open-source or commercial).

facts.text: Common data- and model-versioning tools, whether open-source or commercial, use content hashes.
